item.title: Jamaicans taking measures to manage cooler temperatures associated with strong cold front impacting the island
item.description: According to the Met Office, residents should also expect potentially gale force gusts and cloudy conditions to persist across Jamaica through to Tuesday, especially across northern parishes and hilly areas. item.title: Fire at Riverton City Dump extinguished
item.description: Executive Director of the National Solid Waste Management Authority (NSWMA), Audley Gordon said the fire was put out this afternoon, with help from the Jamaica Fire Brigade. item.title: Gov’t says over $115M disbursed to Jamaicans whose homes were damaged/destroyed by Hurricane Melissa
item.description: The payments were distributed as of Friday January 30. In a statement today, the ministry said under the Restoration of Owner Occupant Family Shelters (ROOFS) Programme,1,305 households have received financial assistance across multiple payment modalities, with all systems now fully activated to accelerate disbursements nationwide. The post Gov’t says over $115M disbursed to Jamaicans whose homes were damaged/destroyed by Hurricane Melissa appeared first on IRIE FM.

item.title: National Security Minister commends JCF for historic reduction in murders last month
item.description: Thirty-three murders were recorded last month. The ministry says this represents a 55 per cent reduction compared to January 2025 and marks the lowest January murder figure recorded in the country in more than 40 years.
